static void amd64_cleanup(void)
{
	u32 tmp;
	int i;

	if (!amd_nb_has_feature(AMD_NB_GART))
		return;

	for (i = 0; i < amd_nb_num(); i++) {
		struct pci_dev *dev = node_to_amd_nb(i)->misc;
		/* disable gart translation */
		pci_read_config_dword(dev, AMD64_GARTAPERTURECTL, &tmp);
		tmp &= ~GARTEN;
		pci_write_config_dword(dev, AMD64_GARTAPERTURECTL, tmp);
	}
}

Callee candidate: amd_flush_garts

void amd_flush_garts(void)
{
	int flushed, i;
	unsigned long flags;
	static DEFINE_SPINLOCK(gart_lock);

	if (!amd_nb_has_feature(AMD_NB_GART))
		return;

	/*
	 */
	spin_lock_irqsave(&gart_lock, flags);
	flushed = 0;
	for (i = 0; i < amd_northbridges.num; i++) {
		pci_write_config_dword(node_to_amd_nb(i)->misc, 0x9c,
				       flush_words[i] | 1);
		flushed++;
	}
	for (i = 0; i < amd_northbridges.num; i++) {
		u32 w;
		/* Make sure the hardware actually executed the flush*/
		for (;;) {
			pci_read_config_dword(node_to_amd_nb(i)->misc,
					      0x9c, &w);
			if (!(w & 1))
				break;
			cpu_relax();
		}
	}
	spin_unlock_irqrestore(&gart_lock, flags);
	if (!flushed)
		pr_notice("nothing to flush?\n");
}

Source code:
int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,
		       sockptr_t optval, unsigned int optlen,
		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

void amd_pmu_disable_virt(void)
{
	struct cpu_hw_events *cpuc = this_cpu_ptr(&cpu_hw_events);

	/*
	 */
	cpuc->perf_ctr_virt_mask = AMD64_EVENTSEL_HOSTONLY;

	/* Reload all events */
	amd_pmu_reload_virt();
}

Callee candidate: amd_pmu_lbr_reset
Source code:
void amd_pmu_lbr_reset(void)
{
	struct cpu_hw_events *cpuc = this_cpu_ptr(&cpu_hw_events);
	int i;

	if (!x86_pmu.lbr_nr)
		return;

	/* Reset all branch records individually */
	for (i = 0; i < x86_pmu.lbr_nr; i++) {
		amd_pmu_lbr_set_from(i, 0);
		amd_pmu_lbr_set_to(i, 0);
	}

	cpuc->last_task_ctx = NULL;
	cpuc->last_log_id = 0;
	wrmsrl(MSR_AMD64_LBR_SELECT, 0);
}

static void amd_threshold_interrupt(void)
{
	struct threshold_block *first_block = NULL, *block = NULL, *tmp = NULL;
	struct threshold_bank **bp = this_cpu_read(threshold_banks);
	unsigned int bank, cpu = smp_processor_id();

	/*
	 */
	if (!bp)
		return;

	for (bank = 0; bank < this_cpu_read(mce_num_banks); ++bank) {
		if (!(per_cpu(bank_map, cpu) & (1 << bank)))
			continue;

		first_block = bp[bank]->blocks;
		if (!first_block)
			continue;

		/*
		 */
		log_and_reset_block(first_block);
		list_for_each_entry_safe(block, tmp, &first_block->miscj, miscj)
			log_and_reset_block(block);
	}
}

int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,
		       sockptr_t optval, unsigned int optlen,
		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

static void __exit amd_uncore_exit(void)
{
	cpuhp_remove_state(CPUHP_AP_PERF_X86_AMD_UNCORE_ONLINE);
	cpuhp_remove_state(CPUHP_AP_PERF_X86_AMD_UNCORE_STARTING);
	cpuhp_remove_state(CPUHP_PERF_X86_AMD_UNCORE_PREP);

	if (boot_cpu_has(X86_FEATURE_PERFCTR_LLC)) {
		perf_pmu_unregister(&amd_llc_pmu);
		free_percpu(amd_uncore_llc);
		amd_uncore_llc = NULL;
	}

	if (boot_cpu_has(X86_FEATURE_PERFCTR_NB)) {
		perf_pmu_unregister(&amd_nb_pmu);
		free_percpu(amd_uncore_nb);
		amd_uncore_nb = NULL;
	}
}

		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

		uncore_msr_uncores[BDX_MSR_UNCORE_SBOX] = NULL;

void blk_io_schedule(void)
{

	unsigned long timeout = sysctl_hung_task_timeout_secs * HZ / 2;

Source code:
int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,
		       sockptr_t optval, unsigned int optlen,
		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,
		       sockptr_t optval, unsigned int optlen,
		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{

	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;

		return -EINVAL;

			release_sock(sk);
			break;

		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;

		break;

			return -ENOPROTOOPT;

			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)

	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

		} else {

			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);

		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;

Source code:
int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,
		       sockptr_t optval, unsigned int optlen,
		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

You are a Linux security expert analyzing kernel call-graph edges.

  - __sys_setsockopt

Source code:
int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,
		       sockptr_t optval, unsigned int optlen,
		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,

		return -EINVAL;

			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);

		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:

			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)

			else

			up->encap_type = val;

			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

			val = USHRT_MAX;

		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */

		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;

	mutex_unlock(&crypto_default_null_skcipher_lock);
}

Source code:
int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,
		       sockptr_t optval, unsigned int optlen,
		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

void __init default_find_smp_config(void)
{
	unsigned int address;

	/*
	 */
	if (smp_scan_config(0x0, 0x400) ||
	    smp_scan_config(639 * 0x400, 0x400) ||
	    smp_scan_config(0xF0000, 0x10000))
		return;
	/*
	 */

	address = get_bios_ebda();
	if (address)
		smp_scan_config(address, 0x400);
}

Source code:
int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,
		       sockptr_t optval, unsigned int optlen,
		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;

int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,
		       sockptr_t optval, unsigned int optlen,
		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

		break;

	/*

	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.

void dma_issue_pending_all(void)
{
	struct dma_device *device;
	struct dma_chan *chan;

	rcu_read_lock();
	list_for_each_entry_rcu(device, &dma_device_list, global_node) {
		if (dma_has_cap(DMA_PRIVATE, device->cap_mask))
			continue;
		list_for_each_entry(chan, &device->channels, device_node)
			if (chan->client_count)
				device->device_issue_pending(chan);
	}
	rcu_read_unlock();
}

Callee candidate: dmaengine_get
Source code:
void dmaengine_get(void)
{
	struct dma_device *device, *_d;
	struct dma_chan *chan;
	int err;

	mutex_lock(&dma_list_mutex);
	dmaengine_ref_count++;

	/* try to grab channels */
	list_for_each_entry_safe(device, _d, &dma_device_list, global_node) {
		if (dma_has_cap(DMA_PRIVATE, device->cap_mask))
			continue;
		list_for_each_entry(chan, &device->channels, device_node) {
			err = dma_chan_get(chan);
			if (err == -ENODEV) {
				/* module removed before we could use it */
				list_del_rcu(&device->global_node);
				break;
			} else if (err)
				dev_dbg(chan->device->dev,
					"%s: failed to get %s: (%d)\n",
					__func__, dma_chan_name(chan), err);
		}
	}

	/* if this is the first reference and there were channels
	 */
	if (dmaengine_ref_count == 1)
		dma_channel_rebalance();
	mutex_unlock(&dma_list_mutex);
}

Source code:
void dmaengine_put(void)
{
	struct dma_device *device, *_d;
	struct dma_chan *chan;

	mutex_lock(&dma_list_mutex);
	dmaengine_ref_count--;
	BUG_ON(dmaengine_ref_count < 0);
	/* drop channel references */
	list_for_each_entry_safe(device, _d, &dma_device_list, global_node) {
		if (dma_has_cap(DMA_PRIVATE, device->cap_mask))
			continue;
		list_for_each_entry(chan, &device->channels, device_node)
			dma_chan_put(chan);
	}
	mutex_unlock(&dma_list_mutex);
}

Source code:
int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,
		       sockptr_t optval, unsigned int optlen,
		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

Source code:
int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,
		       sockptr_t optval, unsigned int optlen,
		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;

{

		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:

			return -EINVAL;

		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

In contrast, `exit_nfs_fs` is a module cleanup function for the NFS filesystem, which is responsible for releasing resources and unregistration of the NFS filesystem when the module is unloaded. It is entirely unrelated to socket option handling or UDP/UDP-Lite behavior.

There is no logical or functional path from `udp_lib_setsockopt` to `exit_nfs_fs`. No control flow can transition from UDP socket configuration to NFS filesystem cleanup, and there is no shared context or dependency that would justify such a transition.

Source code:
int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,
		       sockptr_t optval, unsigned int optlen,
		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,
		       sockptr_t optval, unsigned int optlen,
		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,
		       sockptr_t optval, unsigned int optlen,
		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

static void __exit exit_sd(void)
{
	int i;

	SCSI_LOG_HLQUEUE(3, printk("exit_sd: exiting sd driver\n"));

	scsi_unregister_driver(&sd_template.gendrv);
	mempool_destroy(sd_page_pool);
	kmem_cache_destroy(sd_cdb_cache);

	class_unregister(&sd_disk_class);

	for (i = 0; i < SD_MAJORS; i++)
		unregister_blkdev(sd_major(i), "sd");
}

Caller: udp_lib_setsockopt
Source code:
int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,
		       sockptr_t optval, unsigned int optlen,
		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

	int err = 0;

		return -EINVAL;

			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else

			up->encap_type = val;

			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*

	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;

			val = 8;

		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

static void generic_set_all(void)
{
	unsigned long mask, count;
	unsigned long flags;

	local_irq_save(flags);
	prepare_set();

	/* Actually set the state */
	mask = set_mtrr_state();

	/* also set PAT */
	pat_init();

	post_set();
	local_irq_restore(flags);

	/* Use the atomic bitops to update the global mask */
	for (count = 0; count < sizeof(mask) * 8; ++count) {
		if (mask & 0x01)
			set_bit(count, &smp_changes_mask);
		mask >>= 1;
	}

}

Caller: udp_lib_setsockopt
Source code:
int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,
		       sockptr_t optval, unsigned int optlen,
		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

void hw_breakpoint_restore(void)
{
	set_debugreg(__this_cpu_read(cpu_debugreg[0]), 0);
	set_debugreg(__this_cpu_read(cpu_debugreg[1]), 1);
	set_debugreg(__this_cpu_read(cpu_debugreg[2]), 2);
	set_debugreg(__this_cpu_read(cpu_debugreg[3]), 3);
	set_debugreg(DR6_RESERVED, 6);
	set_debugreg(__this_cpu_read(cpu_dr7), 7);
}

			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)

Source code:
int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,
		       sockptr_t optval, unsigned int optlen,
		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

Callee candidate: i8237A_resume
Source code:
static void i8237A_resume(void)
{
	unsigned long flags;
	int i;

	flags = claim_dma_lock();

	dma_outb(0, DMA1_RESET_REG);
	dma_outb(0, DMA2_RESET_REG);

	for (i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
		set_dma_addr(i, 0x000000);
		/* DMA count is a bit weird so this is not 0 */
		set_dma_count(i, 1);
	}

	/* Enable cascade DMA or channel 0-3 won't work */
	enable_dma(4);

	release_dma_lock(flags);
}

static void i830_chipset_flush(void)
{
	unsigned long timeout = jiffies + msecs_to_jiffies(1000);

	/* Forcibly evict everything from the CPU write buffers.
	 */
	wbinvd_on_all_cpus();

	/* Now we've only seen documents for this magic bit on 855GM,
	 */
	writel(readl(intel_private.registers+I830_HIC) | (1<<31),
	       intel_private.registers+I830_HIC);

	while (readl(intel_private.registers+I830_HIC) & (1<<31)) {
		if (time_after(jiffies, timeout))
			break;

		udelay(50);
	}
}

Source code:
int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,
		       sockptr_t optval, unsigned int optlen,
		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

static void __exit i915_exit(void)
{
	int i;

	for (i = init_progress - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
		GEM_BUG_ON(i >= ARRAY_SIZE(init_funcs));
		if (init_funcs[i].exit)
			init_funcs[i].exit();
	}
}

int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,
		       sockptr_t optval, unsigned int optlen,
		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

Caller: udp_lib_setsockopt
Source code:
int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,
		       sockptr_t optval, unsigned int optlen,
		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

static void intel_820_cleanup(void)
{
	u8 temp;
	struct aper_size_info_8 *previous_size;

	previous_size = A_SIZE_8(agp_bridge->previous_size);
	pci_read_config_byte(agp_bridge->dev, INTEL_I820_RDCR, &temp);

			break;
		}
		break;

		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;

			break;

		break;

		break;

		break;

			return -EINVAL;

static void intel_cleanup(void)
{
	u16 temp;
	struct aper_size_info_16 *previous_size;

	previous_size = A_SIZE_16(agp_bridge->previous_size);
	pci_read_config_word(agp_bridge->dev, INTEL_NBXCFG, &temp);
	pci_write_config_word(agp_bridge->dev, INTEL_NBXCFG, temp & ~(1 << 9));
	pci_write_config_word(agp_bridge->dev, INTEL_APSIZE, previous_size->size_value);
}

static void intel_epb_restore(void)
{
	u64 val = this_cpu_read(saved_epb);
	u64 epb;

	rdmsrl(MSR_IA32_ENERGY_PERF_BIAS, epb);
	if (val) {
		val &= EPB_MASK;
	} else {
		/*
		 */
		val = epb & EPB_MASK;
		if (val == ENERGY_PERF_BIAS_PERFORMANCE) {
			val = energ_perf_values[EPB_INDEX_NORMAL];
			pr_warn_once("ENERGY_PERF_BIAS: Set to 'normal', was 'performance'\n");
		}
	}
	wrmsrl(MSR_IA32_ENERGY_PERF_BIAS, (epb & ~EPB_MASK) | val);
}

        - udp_lib_setsockopt

Caller: udp_lib_setsockopt
Source code:
int udp_lib_setsockopt(struct sock *sk, int level, int optname,
		       sockptr_t optval, unsigned int optlen,
		       int (*push_pending_frames)(struct sock *))
{
	struct udp_sock *up = udp_sk(sk);
	int val, valbool;
	int err = 0;
	int is_udplite = IS_UDPLITE(sk);

	if (optlen < sizeof(int))
		return -EINVAL;

	if (copy_from_sockptr(&val, optval, sizeof(val)))
		return -EFAULT;

	valbool = val ? 1 : 0;

	switch (optname) {
	case UDP_CORK:
		if (val != 0) {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 1);
		} else {
			WRITE_ONCE(up->corkflag, 0);
			lock_sock(sk);
			push_pending_frames(sk);
			release_sock(sk);
		}
		break;

	case UDP_ENCAP:
		switch (val) {
		case 0:
#ifdef CONFIG_XFRM
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP:
		case UDP_ENCAP_ESPINUDP_NON_IKE:
#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6)
			if (sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
				up->encap_rcv = ipv6_stub->xfrm6_udp_encap_rcv;
			else
#endif
				up->encap_rcv = xfrm4_udp_encap_rcv;
#endif
			fallthrough;
		case UDP_ENCAP_L2TPINUDP:
			up->encap_type = val;
			lock_sock(sk);
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
			release_sock(sk);
			break;
		default:
			err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
			break;
		}
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_TX:
		up->no_check6_tx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_NO_CHECK6_RX:
		up->no_check6_rx = valbool;
		break;

	case UDP_SEGMENT:
		if (val < 0 || val > USHRT_MAX)
			return -EINVAL;
		WRITE_ONCE(up->gso_size, val);
		break;

	case UDP_GRO:
		lock_sock(sk);

		/* when enabling GRO, accept the related GSO packet type */
		if (valbool)
			udp_tunnel_encap_enable(sk->sk_socket);
		up->gro_enabled = valbool;
		up->accept_udp_l4 = valbool;
		release_sock(sk);
		break;

	/*
	 */
	/* The sender sets actual checksum coverage length via this option.
	 * The case coverage > packet length is handled by send module. */
	case UDPLITE_SEND_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Illegal coverage: use default (8) */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcslen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_SEND_CC;
		break;

	/* The receiver specifies a minimum checksum coverage value. To make
	 * used, this again means full checksum coverage.                     */
	case UDPLITE_RECV_CSCOV:
		if (!is_udplite)         /* Disable the option on UDP sockets */
			return -ENOPROTOOPT;
		if (val != 0 && val < 8) /* Avoid silly minimal values.       */
			val = 8;
		else if (val > USHRT_MAX)
			val = USHRT_MAX;
		up->pcrlen = val;
		up->pcflag |= UDPLITE_RECV_CC;
		break;

	default:
		err = -ENOPROTOOPT;
		break;
	}

	return err;
}

void intel_gmch_remove(void)
{
	if (--intel_private.refcount)
		return;

	if (intel_private.scratch_page)
		intel_gtt_teardown_scratch_page();
	if (intel_private.pcidev)
		pci_dev_put(intel_private.pcidev);
	if (intel_private.bridge_dev)
		pci_dev_put(intel_private.bridge_dev);
	intel_private.driver = NULL;
}

Callee candidate: intel_iommu_shutdown
Source code:
void intel_iommu_shutdown(void)
{
	struct dmar_drhd_unit *drhd;
	struct intel_iommu *iommu = NULL;

	if (no_iommu || dmar_disabled)
		return;

	down_write(&dmar_global_lock);

	/* Disable PMRs explicitly here. */
	for_each_iommu(iommu, drhd)
		iommu_disable_protect_mem_regions(iommu);

	/* Make sure the IOMMUs are switched off */
	intel_disable_iommus();

	up_write(&dmar_global_lock);
}

static __init void intel_nehalem_quirk(void)
{
	union cpuid10_ebx ebx;

	ebx.full = x86_pmu.events_maskl;
	if (ebx.split.no_branch_misses_retired) {
		/*

		intel_perfmon_event_map[PERF_COUNT_HW_BRANCH_MISSES] = 0x7f89;
		ebx.split.no_branch_misses_retired = 0;
		x86_pmu.events_maskl = ebx.full;
		pr_info("CPU erratum AAJ80 worked around\n");
	}
}
